title: DevopsProject - Data API
description: Represents a DevOps Center project. A project is the primary workspace where teams collaborate to manage changes for an app or customization. This object is the parent for all other DevOps Center objects, including pipelines, environments, and work items. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: A text description of the project's purpose or scope. DevOps Center uses this field only to display the description in the UI.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the project is currently active. The default value is false.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the DevOps Center project.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the project. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **DevopsProjectFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **DevopsProjectHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **DevopsProjectShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
